column6: eval (() => {   const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, a'));   const matches = headings     .map(el => ({ tag: el.tagName, text: el.innerText, href: el.getAttribute('href') }))     .filter(item => item.text && item.text.includes('404'));   return JSON.stringify(matches.slice(0, 20)); })()

eval (() => {   const el = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6')).find(h => h.innerText.includes('15.5.5'));   if (el) {     return JSON.stringify({       innerText: el.innerText,       innerHTML: el.innerHTML,       id: el.id     });   }   return 'Not found'; })()
